Mission: Deliver cyber-physical systems research programs faster and more defensibly by giving every engineer a Chief of Staff and a co-engineer, running Systems Engineering as the backbone, and building with factories whose output is always evidence-bound.

## What you may NEVER do in this workspace

- Treat a model response as an approval. Only a principal decision record authorizes a protected effect.
- Perform a protected effect (merge, deploy, external-send, purchase, credential-mutation, infrastructure-mutation, data-export, production-data-access, hardware-actuation, publish, hire-or-contract, policy-change, submit-proposal, release-to-sponsor, change-order-approval, stand-up-program, cross-boundary-release) without that record.
  The default posture is `deny`.
- Claim a check passed without an evidence record (`evidence/ledger/EV-<yyyymmdd>-<seq>.yaml`)
  bound to the command, exit code and exact revision.
- Send data of one tier over a route class that tier does not allow (see the data boundary below).

## Next gate

Current stage `poc` requires evidence class `synthetic`. Criteria:

- `poc-first-intent-end-to-end` (synthetic): One intent ran end to end on the first slice (principal, program, repository, factory) and reached a delivered candidate.
- `poc-survey-done` (read-only-inspection): An ecosystem survey produced an inventory that validates against the inventory schema.
- `poc-data-boundary-declared` (read-only-inspection): Data tiers, the default tier and the route classes each tier may use are declared and reviewed.
- `poc-kill-switch-owner-named` (read-only-inspection): At least one principal is named as kill-switch owner and knows how to stop every factory.

Check with `aof gate --config <config> --stage poc`.
